AsOfTime.description: An ISO-8601 string representing the time to view the state of the repository.

Dashboard Sheet Description.description: What the Dashboard Sheet is for.

Dashboard Sheet Family.description: Optional grouping tag for the Dashboard Sheet, e.g. 'dashboard' (top-level, user-facing) vs 'panel-library' (reusable sub-sheets meant to be nested, not shown standalone).
Dashboard Sheet Family.Journal Entry: Optional grouping tag for the Container, e.g. 'dashboard' (top-level, user-facing) vs 'panel-library' (reusable sub-containers meant to be nested, not shown standalone).

Dashboard Sheet Heading.description: Display title for the Dashboard Sheet.

Dashboard Sheet Name.description: The unique name of a Dashboard Sheet, held in Egeria as a Dashboard with its layout (a DisplayDataSchemaType, the sheet's DisplayDataContainer, and one DisplayDataField per placement). Used both to name a new Dashboard Sheet (Create Dashboard Sheet) and to refer to an existing one (Link Report to Dashboard Sheet, Add Text on Dashboard Sheet).
Dashboard Sheet Name.Journal Entry: The unique name of a Container — a local pyegeria-managed record (see Container/ContainerDict in pyegeria.view._output_container_models), not an Egeria element. Used both to define a new Container's identity (Create Container) and to reference an existing one (Link Report to Container). 2026-11-10: wording updated -- since 6.2.29 the sheet is held in Egeria (§8d chain); the local store is a fallback.

Effective Time.description: An ISO-8601 string representing the time to use for evaluating effectivity of the elements related to this one.

Ends With.description: If true, look for matches with the search string starting from the end of  a field.

Governance Zone Filter.description: Include only elements in one of the specified governance zones.

Graph Query Depth.description: The depth of the hierarchy to return. Default is 5. Specifying 0 returns only the top level attributes.

Ignore Case.description: If true, ignore the difference between upper and lower characters when matching the search string.

Include Only Classified Elements.description: Include only elements with the specified classifications.

Include Only Relationships.description: Include information only about specified relationships.

Limit Result by Status.description: One of the status values from a list of valid values.

MD Content.description: Markdown text to display at this placement -- section headers, explanations, captions. Rendered as-is (mermaid fences supported). Held in Egeria as the placement's markdownContent.

Metadata Element Subtype Names.description: Filter results by the list of metadata elements. If none are provided, then no status filtering will be performed.

Metadata Element Type Name.description: Optionally filter results by the type of metadata element.

Order Property Name.description: The property to use for sorting if the sort_order_property is PROPERTY_ASCENDING or PROPERTY_DESCENDING

Output Format.description: Output format for the report: one of the formats pyegeria's report-spec registry supports, plus KPI. Stored in Report.outputFormat (Egeria 6.3) and validated against Egeria's valid metadata values for outputFormat when the server has them.

Output Sort Order.description: How to order the results. The sort order can be selected from a list of valid value.

Page Size.description: The number of elements returned per page.

Placement Emphasis.description: Presentation hint for a Report Spec placed in a Dashboard Sheet — 'kpi' (compact tile) or 'panel' (larger, detailed).
Placement Emphasis.Journal Entry: Presentation hint for a Report Spec placed in a Container — 'kpi' (compact tile) or 'panel' (larger, detailed).

Placement Name.description: Stable identifier for this text placement within its Dashboard Sheet — re-running with the same Dashboard Sheet Name + Placement Name updates it in place, same as Report placements are replaced by Report Name.
Placement Name.Journal Entry: Presentation hint for a Report Spec placed in a Container — 'kpi' (compact tile) or 'panel' (larger, detailed).

Placement Span.description: Layout width hint for a Report Spec placed in a Dashboard Sheet — '1'/'2' (relative columns) or 'full' (row width).
Placement Span.Journal Entry: Layout width hint for a Report Spec placed in a Container — '1'/'2' (relative columns) or 'full' (row width).

Report Name.description: The name of a report asset.

Report Parameters.description: Name-Value pairs of extra parameters for the target Report Spec's action that aren't part of the standard find/search attribute set (e.g. collection_guid for the "Collection Members" report). Keys must match exactly what the target report spec's action expects.
Report Parameters.Journal Entry: Name-Value pairs of extra parameters for the target Report Spec's action that aren't part of the standard find/search attribute set (e.g. collection_guid for the "Collection Members" report). Keys must match exactly what the target report spec's ActionParameter.required_params/optional_params expect (snake_case, e.g. "collection_guid") -- format_set_executor.py does a direct params[key] lookup with no aliasing.

Report Spec.description: The name of the report spec (FormatSet) to run, e.g. 'Digital-Products', 'Collections', 'My-User-MD'. This is the primary identifier for the report — equivalent to --report in the CLI.

Search String.description: An optional search string to filter results by.

Skip Classified Elements.description: Skip elements with the any of the specified classifications.

Skip Relationships.description: Allow listed relationships to be skipped in the output returned.

Start From.description: When paging through results, the starting point of the results to return.

Starts With.description: If true, look for matches with the search string starting from the beginning of  a field.

Query URL.description: The REST URL used to issue the saved query.

Query Request Body.description: The REST request body (typically JSON) used to issue the saved query.

Saved Query.description: A saved query name. Preferably a qualified name.

Results Set.description: A results set (collection) name. Preferably a qualified name.

Placement Perspectives.description: Comma-separated viewer-role/perspective tags this placement is relevant to (e.g. governance, steward, owner, consumer, engineer, builder, privacy, community -- the same vocabulary Egeria Overview's own perspective filtering uses). Empty means relevant to every perspective.

Placement Detail Spec.description: Optional drill-down target -- the name of another Report Spec to navigate to for more detail on this placement's result.

Aliases.description: Alternative names for this  field, used in different systems or contexts.

Microflow.description: The report spec's micro-flow, parameters and formatters, as microflow/1 JSON: {"format": "microflow/1", "params": {name: {type, default, required}}, "stages": [...], "formatters": {OUTPUT_TYPE: {"columns": [...]}}}. A find stage names its method as Class.method (read-only: find_, get_ or list_); an analytic stage names a registered analytic. A bare JSON list of stages (the older format 0) is accepted and converted to microflow/1 when written. Invalid JSON is an error.
Microflow.Journal Entry: 2026-11-07 -- Egeria 6.3 report specs / measurements / dashboards (odpi/egeria#9432). 2026-11-08 -- RS-EGERIA-TIER stage 1: stored as microflow/1; a bare list (format 0) is converted.

Target Type Name.description: The type of element the report spec reports on.

Output Types.description: The output formats that can be generated from this report spec.

Include Preamble.description: Should the preamble be included in the report?

Refresh Time Interval.description: How often the dashboard refreshes, in minutes (Egeria refreshTimeInterval).

Layout Style.description: The style of layout used to arrange the reports in a dashboard. Validated against Egeria's valid metadata values for layoutStyle.

Report.description: A report name. Preferably a qualified name.

Report Type.description: A report type (for example a report spec) name. Preferably a qualified name.

Result State.description: Status of the results of this report run. Validated against Egeria's valid metadata values for resultState.

Result State Reason.description: Reason for the result state. Validated against Egeria's valid metadata values for resultStateReason.

Result Location.description: Where the results of this run are stored.

Dashboard Owner.description: The userId that owns the sheet's Dashboard (its Ownership classification, owner type UserIdentity). Leave it empty for the user the command runs as (in the Portal, by default, its service user). Set once: a Dashboard that already has an owner keeps it. Not written to Egeria with --local-only or with no Egeria connection.
Dashboard Owner.Journal Entry: 2026-11-10: added -- Create Dashboard Sheet sets Ownership the way `pyegeria.view.dashboards migrate --owner` does (DB-3).

Formula.description: The logic implemented by this process, expressed in the language of the business rather than any one implementation language.

Formula Type.description: The specification language used to express the Formula (e.g. SQL, Python, natural language).

View Report.description: Runs a named pyegeria report spec (FormatSet) via hey_egeria run_report. Returns formatted output from the Egeria repository — not an element creation command.
View Report.Journal Entry: Runs a pyegeria report spec via hey_egeria run_report. Discovers and executes a named FormatSet against the Egeria repository. Not an element-creation command — no upsert, no qualified name prefix. Output format and report spec control what is returned and how it is rendered.

Create Report.description: Defines a report with optional default parameters set, that can be placed on a Dashboard.

Create Dashboard Sheet.description: Creates or updates a Dashboard Sheet: a named, ordered layout of report and text placements, held in Egeria as a Dashboard with its layout (a DisplayDataSchemaType, the sheet's DisplayDataContainer, and one DisplayDataField per placement). Re-running it updates the sheet in place. The local JSON store (PYEGERIA_DASHBOARD_SHEETS_STORE) is a fallback: with --local-only or no Egeria connection, only the store is written, and the command output says so.
Create Dashboard Sheet.Journal Entry: Creates or updates a Dashboard Sheet, written to Egeria as the §8d chain: Dashboard (Dashboard::<name>) --Schema--> DisplayDataSchemaType --AttributeForSchema--> DisplayDataContainer (the sheet); placements are DisplayDataFields under it. Upsert by qualifiedName. 2026-11-07: dropped the 'Dashboard' alias -- 'Create Dashboard' now creates an Egeria Dashboard (odpi/egeria#9432). 2026-11-10: wording updated -- since 6.2.29 the sheet is held in Egeria (§8d chain); the local store is a fallback.

Link Report to Dashboard Sheet.description: Places a Report into a Dashboard Sheet as an ordered placement, with layout hints (span and emphasis). In Egeria the placement is a DisplayDataField of the sheet, and the Report is linked from the Dashboard (DataSetContent). Re-running it with the same Report Name updates the placement in place. The Dashboard Sheet must already exist (Create Dashboard Sheet). The local JSON store (PYEGERIA_DASHBOARD_SHEETS_STORE) is a fallback: with --local-only or no Egeria connection, only the store is written, and the command output says so.
Link Report to Dashboard Sheet.bundle: Report to Dashboard Sheet Link Base
Link Report to Dashboard Sheet.Journal Entry: Places a Report into a Dashboard Sheet as an ordered placement (DisplayDataField, placementKind 'report'), with span/emphasis; the Report is linked by DataSetContent from the Dashboard. 2026-11-10: wording updated -- since 6.2.29 the sheet is held in Egeria (§8d chain); the local store is a fallback.

Add Text on Dashboard Sheet.description: Places literal markdown text (a section header, explanation, or caption) into a Dashboard Sheet as an ordered placement, alongside Report placements. In Egeria the placement is a DisplayDataField of the sheet that holds the text. Re-running it with the same Placement Name updates it in place. The Dashboard Sheet must already exist (Create Dashboard Sheet). The local JSON store (PYEGERIA_DASHBOARD_SHEETS_STORE) is a fallback: with --local-only or no Egeria connection, only the store is written, and the command output says so.
Add Text on Dashboard Sheet.Journal Entry: Places markdown text into a Dashboard Sheet as an ordered placement (DisplayDataField, placementKind 'text', markdownContent). 2026-11-10: wording updated -- since 6.2.29 the sheet is held in Egeria (§8d chain); the local store is a fallback.

Create Saved Query.description: Defines a saved query -- a RESTful query to Egeria that returns Open Metadata Elements -- that can be connected to a Results Set via the SmartQuery relationship (Egeria PR #9200, 0725 Smart Collections).

Link Saved Query to Results Set.display_name: Link Saved Query to Results Set
Link Saved Query to Results Set.description: Connects a Saved Query to a Results Set via the SmartQuery relationship (0725 Smart Collections), indicating the results set is populated by the saved query.

Create Report Spec.description: Creates or updates a report specification held in Egeria (ReportSpec, a ReportType collection): its micro-flow, target type, aliases and output types.

Create Dashboard.description: Creates or updates a Dashboard held in Egeria (a DataSet asset, sibling of Report). Its sheets and placements are DisplayDataContainers and DisplayDataFields.

Link Report Type Instance.description: Link a report type (for example a report spec) to a report generated from it (ReportTypeInstance relationship).

Link Report Run Of.description: Link a results set to the report it is a run of, with the run's result state (ReportRunOf relationship: ResultsSet -> Report).
